# [TASK] ai-service: aggregate structured filter across actor-service and movie-service

## Task
Execute a structured filter across actor-service (person/role/collaborator
credits) and movie-service (catalog/discover), merging into one movie
result set.

## Parent Story
Parent: #198

## Scope
Aggregation logic only — consumes the structured filter #202 produces,
via a new `QueryAggregationService` and `ActorCatalogClient` (mirroring
`MovieCatalogClient`'s existing shape), exposed through a new
`POST /api/v1/ai/search/execute` endpoint. Rescoped in one respect from
the original text: results are a flat, bounded list (capped at 200), not
a paginated envelope — no acceptance criterion below required pagination,
and a search-bar result list doesn't need one the way a browsable catalog
page does; stated here rather than left as a silent mismatch with the
Task's original description.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Person + role (acted/directed/produced) + year range resolves to the correct filtered movie set — verified end to end via WireMock across both actor-service (search + crew credits) and movie-service (discover), including a real directing credit outside the year range being correctly dropped
- [x] Multiple collaborator constraints (AND semantics) narrow results correctly — verified with 2 collaborators arranged so applying only one of them would silently produce a different, wrong result
- [x] Negation constraints exclude matching movies rather than being ignored — verified for `DIRECTED`/`PRODUCED` (cast filmography minus the negated role's credits) and for `ACTED` (no resolvable candidate set exists for "not starring X" with this system's data, so it degrades to empty rather than the wrong unfiltered filmography — a real bug an independent review caught in an earlier version of this code, fixed and regression-tested)
- [x] Plain-title fallback delegates to movie-service's existing `/search` unchanged — verified it returns movie-service's data verbatim, and separately verified zero actor-service calls happen on this path (a true short-circuit, not a coincidence)
- [x] WireMock-backed integration tests cover at least one multi-service, multi-constraint query end to end

## Estimate
**Hours:** 8

## Notes
`RestClientConfig` gained an `actorServiceRestClient` bean following ADR-020's private-builder-plus-interceptor pattern. `ActorCatalogClient` and `MovieCatalogClient` both `@Qualifier` their `RestClient` params now that two named beans exist. New client-side DTOs mirror the real response shapes; `ActorCatalogClient` unwraps actor-service's `ApiResponse<T>` envelope, which movie-service does not use.

Stated gap: a negated `role=ACTED` ("not starring X") degrades to an empty result, because no service exposes "movies X is absent from". Explicit, and regression-tested.

A missing `ACTOR_SERVICE_BASE_URL` in 3 of 4 k8s overlays was found here and tracked separately as #228 — editing deployment manifests is outside this Task's scope.
